'''2025 US Nationals Chris Westergard LS Clones''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Chris Westergard]] at [[2025 U.S. National Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Chris Westergard]]
* '''Event:''' [[2025 U.S. National Championship]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hunt For The Droid General / He's A Coward|V21-L-huntforthedroidgeneral.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:25Nats Westergard LS Clones.txt |Download]]
